refreshNotes: Carryover of the 3rd-generation Revero EREV (introduced for MY2025) with no announced powertrain changes. Karma's public statements treat the 2025 and 2026 Reveros as a single 160-unit limited production run; the 2026 model is now available at US Karma dealers. Sources: https://karmaautomotive.com/revero/, https://www.karmawestfield.com/new-inventory/karma-revero.htm
